 Home Designer Software is the top-rated 3D interior design, remodeling and home design software. ## Home Designer Products

Advanced building tools for roofs, foundations and framing make the design process easy. As you draw walls, the program creates a 3D model. When you place a door or window, it is inserted into the wall and the program automatically updates the framing. When you move walls, the roof and foundation are also updated. Every item you add into the design is included in a list of materials so you can cost estimate and budget your home project.

Remodeling a kitchen or bath? Cabinets are smart objects that snap, bump and form to walls. You will find a large selection of cabinet types. Quickly change colors and styles with the Material Painter to visualize design options.

Chief Architect offers three DIY software products—[Suite](/products/home-designer-suite/), [Architectural](/products/home-designer-architectural/) and [Pro](/products/home-designer-pro/). Its professional architectural software line offers products for full residential design.

Our [3D Library](https://www.chiefarchitect.com/3d-library/go/?family=Home%20Designer) has thousands of paints, materials and furnishings to make the interior design match your exact needs.

## Home Designer

content.text:
I built the site as a single page: `index.html` in the project folder. Open it directly in a browser; it uses the images in `images/` and needs no build step. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is untested.

It includes:
- **Header:** a utility bar (My Account, Contact Us, Cart) and a sticky navigation bar with dropdown menus.
- **Hero:** the "Home Design Software for DIY" intro, the Trial and Purchase buttons, and the Pro box shot with the Rent $59/mo. button.
- **Quick links:** Download, Explore and Learn.
- **Products:** both text blocks and cards for Suite, Architectural and Pro with the prices from `copy.md`. A Chief Architect Professional banner follows them.
- **Remodeling section:** the home, interior design and remodeling copy.
- **About section:** the "Powerful, Fun and Easy" copy beside `professional_2.png`.
- **Learn More:** the list of learning links.
- **Purchase options:** a New/Upgrade toggle with product, media and backup dropdowns. It shows the price for the chosen product, and Rent appears only for Pro.
- **Footer:** the five link columns, social links and the copyright line.

The page is responsive and collapses to a single column on phones.

- **Links:** the site-relative links in `copy.md` (such as `/products/trial.html`) now point to `https://www.homedesignersoftware.com/...`, so they don't break when the page is opened locally.
- **Prices:** the purchase-options prices come from the product cards, since the copy gave no separate figures. The Buy button goes to the shopping-cart page, not a specific product.
